definitions.explanation: Having value or purpose; worth spending time or effort on. Used to describe experiences, time, discussions, and activities that produce something positive.

examples.japanese: {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were able to have a very worthwhile discussion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{有意義|ゆういぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm reading to make good use of my day off.

notes:
{有意義|ゆういぎ} is a na-adjective meaning something has real value or purpose — worth the time and effort invested.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (meaningful time)
- Adverbial: {有意義|ゆういぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend meaningfully)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (meaningful time)
- {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (worthwhile experience)
- {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ (meaningful discussion)
- {有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (worthwhile activity)
- {有意義|ゆういぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to put to good use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無意味|むいみ}→無意味：15527_muimi⟧: meaningless, pointless (closer antonym in everyday use)
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧: wasteful, useless (focuses on wasted effort)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Often used in speeches, evaluations, and reflections. Very common after events or experiences: ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{有意義|ゆういぎ}な⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧でした (It was a very meaningful day).
